About the Firm
Stephen Wang + Assoc. is a long established successful NYC practice specializing in high-end residential architecture and interiors: apartment renovations, combinations and rooftop additions, townhouse renovations, and ground-up residences across the continental U.S. along with select commercial office and retail work.
The Role
We are seeking a talented, motivated, and detail-oriented Junior Interior Architectural Designer with a strong design sensibility and solid CAD skills. You will contribute to every phase of residential interiors — kitchens, baths, custom millwork, lighting, and finishes — from early concepts and material selection through construction documents and site work.
